text:
Leah M: Heads up 1: we need a prioritization rubric for DP invites that hooks into roadmap tradeoffs. Can we agree on buckets by EOD?

Omar J: Proposal: three buckets. Tier A = production-ready infra + dedicated PM + committed usage (>=3k tokens/day). Tier B = good infra, exploratory PM, lower volume (>=500 tokens/day). Tier C = research partners or early explorers (no usage req).

Tara P: +1 but add "privacy class" check: Tier A must sign our standard DP DPA + no PII ingestion. Tier B can use our sandbox with stricter logging. Tier C gets anonymized outputs only.

Ben S: For roadmap prioritization we should map Tier A partners to features with highest launch dependency. e.g., if a partner needs multi-turn state, that bumps the feature up a sprint.

Leah M: Good point. We also need a simple SLO exception process when partners want custom latency targets. Suggest: product approves exceptions if partner commits to >=6 months + business case. Engineering signs off for feasibility.

Omar J: Can ops-bot record an exception ticket template? ops-bot: created ticket DP-SLO-EX-42 for SLO exception template.

Tara P: Instrumentation checklist draft: session_id present, dp_cohort tag, prompt_hash, model_version, client_region, and explicit consent flag. Minimal schema:

```
# example session metadata to include
session_id: <uuid>
dp_cohort: spring-2026
partner_id: <slug>
consent: true
```

Ben S: For consent text, Legal wants a short, clear blurb. Draft: "By participating you consent to sharing anonymized session logs and evaluation results with Redwood for product improvement and research. No PII will be shared." LegalBot: please confirm.

LegalBot: Approved with minor edits. Add: "Partners may opt out of case studies."

Leah M: Noted. Incentives: small credit + monthly review call. Also consider co-marketing for Tier A on graduation.

Omar J: Metrics for graduation: sustained weekly active sessions for 3 weeks, no critical regressions, and feedback NPS >= 6/10. We need numeric thresholds in the invite doc.

Tara P: Can we define "critical regression"? Suggest: drop in median quality score >10% or any single daily spike in false-positive rate >15%.

Ben S: Also track operational signals: token error rate <1%, queue length under 50ms p95 for 95% of requests, and no data retention policy violations.

Leah M: Recruitment mechanics: product to shortlist 12 prospects, ops to confirm capacity (slots), eng to estimate integration effort. Then run a one-week smoke test for top 6.

ops-bot: capacity check: 5 DP slots available the week of 1767811000.

Omar J: Gap: onboarding docs need a lightweight quickstart that non-engineers can follow. Tara, can design a 1-pager for partner PMs?

Tara P: On it. Will include a checklist and a "who to ping" escalation table.

Ben S: For evaluation harness, we'll provide a hosted eval collector and a CLI to push golden prompts + telemetry. Quick CLI example to tag sessions:

```bash
redwood-cli send-session --session-id abcd1234 --meta '{"dp_cohort":"spring-2026","partner_id":"acme-co","consent":true}'
```

Leah M: Action items: Omar = finalize buckets + numeric thresholds; Tara = onboarding 1-pager + quickstart; Ben = eval CLI + golden prompt list; Ops = confirm slots and SLO exception flow; LegalBot = final consent copy. I'll assemble the invite template and share for review.

Omar J: timeline?

Leah M: Draft invite out by Tue EOD, send Wed. Smoke test next week, live cohort starts in two weeks.

Tara P: ack

Ben S: ack

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: send-invite-template at 1767880000.

LegalBot: consent copy posted to /legal/dp-consent.

Leah M: Thanks all 33
